item.title: Housing Options: Build vs. Buy & Other Life Updates
item.description: House hunting or building. Work's busy with new projects. Switched from Proxmox to TrueNAS; planning server upgrades soon.

item.title: Life, Work, Tech: Health Journey, Home Search, IT Setup
item.description: Join me as I navigate a weight loss journey, search for a new home, and balance a demanding IT job. Explore my tech setup with Proxmox, Pop!_OS, and robust backup solutions for a resilient digital environment.

item.title: Recent Challenges: Contract Work and Proxmox Server Issues
item.description: Navigating project cancellations and server setup issues: the challenges of contract work and Proxmox server installations.

item.title: Proxmox Server Upgrade: Solving Case and Heat Sink Issues
item.description: Encountering issues while upgrading your Proxmox server to a 1U rack mount case? Discover the challenges with motherboard stand-offs and heat sink compatibility, and learn how to address them effectively.

item.title: Optimized Proxmox Backup: Local Windows Share & Backblaze
item.description: Efficient Proxmox backup: 4x500GB SSDs, Windows 10 share for ISO/backups, auto-sync to Backblaze for reliable offsite protection.

item.title: Upgrading Proxmox with 4x 500GB SSDs and ZFS
item.description: Integrate four 500GB SSDs into your Proxmox server with a ZFS setup. Learn about the striped and mirrored configuration for nearly 1TB of storage and get ready for a video tutorial on migrating to a 1U rackmount case.

item.title: Exciting Upgrades: Syncthing Tutorial, Hugo Migration, New Gear
item.description: Busy with work and life but planning new projects: Syncthing video, Hugo site migration, server upgrades, and networking enhancements.

item.title: Updating Tech Plans: Delaying pfSense on Proxmox, New Content
item.description: Delaying pfSense installation on Proxmox to focus on updating Computer Hacking 101 and creating new YouTube content. Considering whether to install pfSense on bare metal or Proxmox.

item.title: Upgrading Network: Adding 4-Port Ethernet Card to Proxmox
item.description: Upgraded my network with a 4-port Ethernet card for Proxmox and pfSense, adding VLANs for IoT and server management, plus two Pi-holes for DNS.
